mapper.select: SELECT authority_code, node_id, can_view_store, can_manage_store FROM authority_node_permission WHERE authority_code = #{authorityCode} ORDER BY node_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO authority_node_permission(authority_code, node_id, can_view_store, can_manage_store) VALUES(#{authorityCode}, #{nodeId}, #{canViewStore}, #{canManageStore}) ON CONFLICT(authority_code, node_id) DO UPDATE SET can_view_store = EXCLUDED.can_view_store, can_manage_store = EXCLUDED.can_manage_store
